description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Resource_Php, which implements a PHP-based file system resource for Smarty templates. It manages loading template content, populating compiled file paths, and rendering templates without compilation. The class extends Smarty_Internal_Resource_File and provides methods for resource handling specific to PHP templates within the Smarty templating system.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Resource_Php
classes.description: A class that implements Smarty's internal resource handling for PHP templates, using the file system as the resource backend, extending Smarty_Internal_Resource_File.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the resource object, capturing the current setting of 'short_open_tag' from PHP ini settings.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Loads the template source content from a file; throws an exception if unable to load.

methods.name: populateCompiledFilepath
methods.description: Populates the compiled template object with filepath, timestamp, existence flag, and file dependency info based on the source.

methods.name: renderUncompiled
methods.description: Renders the template directly without compiling, enabling short open tags during execution, and restoring the ini setting afterward.
